devices.title: Devices & stations
devices.description: POS registers, handhelds and kitchen displays, kitchen stations and printers at this location.
devices.noLocation: First choose a location at the top.
devices.readOnly: View only: changes require the “Manage location, devices and tables” permission.

terminals.title: POS registers & devices
terminals.hint: Each device is connected once with a pairing code. Deactivating it unpairs it immediately.
terminals.empty: No devices yet. Create at least one POS register.
terminals.prefixLabel: Prefix for order numbers when offline
terminals.prefixHint: 1–4 capital letters or digits, e.g. K1. Unique per location, so order numbers assigned offline are never duplicated.
terminals.prefixTaken: Another device at this location already uses this prefix.
terminals.stationHint: For kitchen displays: which station the device shows.
terminals.pairingInstruction: Enter it on the device: open the POS register or kitchen display on the device and type in this code when pairing.
terminals.pairingOnce: The code is shown only now and works for a single pairing. A new code replaces the previous one; if the device is already paired, the new pairing replaces the old one.
terminals.reactivateFirst: Activate the device before pairing it.
terminals.deactivateText: The device is locked as soon as it connects and cannot work until it is activated again and paired with a new code. Orders and receipts are kept.
terminals.activateText: Activating it creates a new pairing code to enter on the device.

stations.title: Kitchen stations
stations.hint: Every product goes to a station; its tickets appear there on the kitchen display or printer.
stations.alertAfterHint: Leave empty to use the location default ({minutes} min).
stations.inUse: The station is still used by products, kitchen displays or as another station’s replacement. Reassign them first or deactivate the station.
stations.noOutputHint: This station has neither a kitchen display nor a printer: its tickets show up nowhere.
stations.fallbackLabel: If nobody is there, send to
stations.fallbackHint: When nobody is logged in on a display of this station (or it has neither a display nor a printer), its tickets go to this station. The POS asks first.

printers.title: Printers
printers.hint: Network printers for receipts and kitchen tickets.
printers.inUse: Stations or devices still print to this printer. Assign them to another printer first.
printers.hubNote: Printing goes through the location hub on the local network (ESC/POS, port 9100). The test page reaches the hub with the next sync.
printers.testRequested: Test page requested. The result shows here once the hub has printed.

users.title: Staff
users.description: Access to the POS register with a PIN and to the backoffice with email and password.
users.name: Name
users.emailHint: For signing in to the backoffice.
users.emailTaken: This email is already in use.
users.passwordHint: Optional. Only needed for backoffice access; at least 10 characters.
users.passwordNeedsEmail: Backoffice access also requires an email.
users.pinHint: Optional. 4–6 digits to unlock the POS register.
users.pinInvalid: The PIN consists of 4 to 6 digits.
users.rolesHint: The roles apply at all selected locations.
users.pickRole: Please choose at least one role.
users.pickLocation: Please choose at least one location.
users.setPinHint: 4–6 digits. The PIN identifies the person at the POS register and must be unique within the organisation.
users.noEmailWarning: This person has no email. Without an email, signing in to the backoffice isn’t possible.
users.deactivateText: The person can no longer sign in or unlock the POS register. Their data and the audit log are kept.
users.activateText: The person can sign in again and work with their PIN.
users.lastAdmin: The organisation needs at least one active person with the Administrator role.

roles.hint: Permissions apply to everyone with this role. Every change is logged.
roles.adminLocked: The Administrator role always has all permissions and can’t be changed.

order.any_table: Work on any table, also when tables belong to their waiter

cash.open_drawer: Open the cash drawer without a sale

user.manage: Manage staff, roles and API keys

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For the website and other apps (e.g. Zitas). A key applies to the whole organisation.
apiKeys.name: Label
apiKeys.nameHint: What the key is used for, e.g. “Website”.
apiKeys.pickScope: Please choose at least one permission.
apiKeys.revokeText: Apps using this key lose access immediately. This can’t be undone.
apiKeys.keyWarning: Copy the key and store it securely, e.g. in a password manager. Afterwards only the prefix will be visible. If it gets lost, revoke it and create a new one.
apiKeys.copyFailed: Copying isn’t possible. Please select the key and copy it manually.

scopeDescriptions.catalog_read: Retrieve products, categories, prices and menu.
scopeDescriptions.catalog_write: Change products and prices and report sold-out items.

phones.title: Service phones
phones.hint: Service staff pair their own phone with a code (here or at the cashier) and their PIN. Signing out unpairs it and erases its data.
phones.codeInstruction: The server scans the QR code with their own phone (or types the code), then enters their PIN.
phones.codeShared: While it is valid, the code works for several phones. Each one also needs the server’s PIN.
phones.qrLabel: QR code to pair a service phone
phones.stale: Paired since an earlier day: did someone forget to sign out?
phones.empty: No server has paired their phone yet. Create a code here, or at the cashier with the phone icon.
phones.unpairText: The phone is unpaired at once. Anything not sent yet stays on the phone until it is paired again.
phones.deactivateText: This person can no longer pair their own phone until you activate it again.
phones.activateText: The person can pair their phone again with a code and their PIN.
